Employee.title: Employee
Employee.description: An active SIBS-Mart store employee selectable on the attendance form.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the employee was added.

AttendanceLog.title: AttendanceLog
AttendanceLog.description: A daily check-in/check-out or leave (Ijin/Libur) record for an employee.

employeeName.description: Employee name at the time of recording.

checkInTime.description: Check-in time in HH:mm format or empty string for leave.

checkOutTime.description: Check-out time in HH:mm format or empty string if not checked out.

lateMinutes.description: Minutes past shift start if late, otherwise 0.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the log was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the log was last updated.

StoreSettings.title: StoreSettings
StoreSettings.description: Shared store settings synced across all devices, including Admin PIN hash and shift grace minutes.

adminPinHash.description: Salted SHA-256 hash of the Admin PIN.

graceMinutes.description: Late tolerance minutes after shift start.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the last settings update.

/employees/{employeeId}.description: Active employee names synchronized across all kiosk and phone devices.

/attendance_logs/{logId}.description: Real-time employee check-in, check-out, and leave (Ijin/Libur) records.

/settings/{settingId}.description: Store-wide configuration document (store) synchronized across devices.
